correctness.rationale: The binary morphism gives the exact recurrence for three distinct zero-gap lengths. Induction proves the five admissible gap digrams, maximal all-\(A\) gap runs of length \(a\) with fixed flank and maximal alternating \(B,C\) runs of length four. Exhaustive cases for reversible factors bound their lengths by \(a^2+3a-1\) when \(a\ge4\); explicit palindromes attain the bound. For \(a=3\), the localization lemma reduces all length-\(19\) factors to \(W_3\), and the replayable complete enumeration of \(37\) factors excludes every reversed pair while a length-\(18\) palindrome exists. All quantifiers and initial-prefix boundaries are addressed. Finite sample checks alone are not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A sharp intrinsic factor-language cutoff for an infinite, natural one-parameter Chacon family, with nontrivial exceptional parameter, quadratic growth, explicit palindromic equality witness and a structural gap-run mechanism. This improves qualitatively on generic existence or classical single-parameter results and requires neither an invented application nor a complete unrelated factor-complexity formula.
